average_checkpoints: average the model weights from multiple PyTorch checkpoint files into a single checkpoint
run_average_checkpoints_cli: run the CLI tool to average input checkpoint files and write the result to an output path
last_n_checkpoints: find the last N checkpoint files in a directory by epoch or update number
run_average_last_n_epoch_checkpoints: run the CLI with --num-epoch-checkpoints to average the last N epoch-based checkpoints in a directory
run_average_last_n_update_checkpoints: run the CLI with --num-update-checkpoints to average the last N update-based checkpoints in a directory
